name: refstats
description: RefStats — hakemler için kişisel maç, istatistik ve kariyer platformu

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
